messages:
anthony: Heads-up: rolling BMC firmware (vendor v2.13.0) across eu-west GPU nodes in 20m. This includes microcode + BMC reboot; vendor notes secure-boot toggles possible on some iLO variants.

jess: Ack. Which host pool? Any expected node reboots that affect live pods? :thinking:

anthony: Pool is eu-west-gpu-1 (racks r6-r9). Hosts will OOB-reboot; k8s drain configured with `--delete-local-data --ignore-daemonsets`.

miguel: Noted. How many GPUs will be out at peak?

anthony: Expect ~18 nodes (36 GPUs) out concurrently for ~5-10m each. Roughly 22% capacity impact for that pool.

anita: Can we route inference traffic to dedicated-reserve until rollout finishes? I'll update the routing policy.

anthony: Yes, please set routing to fallback:demand->dedicated-reserve for the next 2h.

jess: Vendor reported a previous image where BMC firmware flipped secureboot flag -> UEFI refused to boot on nvme. Any test results from canaries?

miguel: We ran the canary (r6-02). After BMC reboot it toggled secureboot=enabled and the machine dropped to grub rescue. Had to reflash BIOS and clear db using vendor tool. Log snippet:
```
Jan 12 10:18:22 r6-02 kernel: EFI: Secure Boot enabled
Jan 12 10:18:24 r6-02 grub: error: no such device: 1234-ABCD
```
Workaround was `vendor-tool reset-secureboot --allow` then `ipmitool chassis power cycle`.

anthony: Important: do NOT run automated firmware on next batch until we verify secure-boot preserve flag. Pausing after r6-r7.

eng-deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: bmc-update eu-west-gpu-1 batch r6 (start in 20m). Status: queued.

anita: I'm applying routing change now and opening a short-lived capacity alert to avoid autoscaler shrinking other pools.

vendor-support: We're investigating a regression in v2.13.0 that may reset SB keys on certain board revisions. ETA 2h for patch. If you can provide board serials from failed nodes that helps.

jess: Collecting serials and adding to the ticket. Also, @oncall, please stand by for possible manual intervention; we'll likely need to `ipmitool raw` to flip protections.

miguel: Command we used:
```
ipmitool -I lanplus -H $BMC -U admin -P **** raw 0x30 0x45 0x01
```
It cleared the lock and allowed reboot.

anthony: OK. Plan: Pause after r6 batch, run deeper validation (boot + kernel verify) on two more canaries. If secureboot preserved, continue. If not, vendor patch only.

jess: Thanks. I'll update runbook and notify SRE rota. :thumbsup:

anita: Routing change complete. Redirected ~150k requests/min to dedicated-reserve. Monitoring CPU/GPU queuing.

ops-bot: alert: eu-west-gpu-1 capacity degraded -> 22% less available GPUs. auto-scaling disabled by admin for 40m.

anthony: Keep this thread for updates. I'll post canary results in ~30m.
